s.note: Smoky South African relish of peppers, carrot, beans and chilli, with charred bread
s.how: Soften the onion in the oil with the garlic, ginger and chilli. Add the capsicums and carrot and cook 5 minutes. Stir in the curry powder and paprika, then the tomatoes and baked beans. Simmer 15 minutes until thick. Slice and char the bread on a hot grill pan. Serve with the chakalaka, warm or at room temperature, and scatter with coriander.

s.note: Mango, papaya, pineapple and passionfruit with lime, chilli salt and mint
s.how: Cut 2 mangoes, half a papaya and a quarter pineapple into wedges and lay on ice with the pulp of 2 passionfruit. Squeeze over lime and sprinkle with a pinch of chilli salt and torn mint.

m.note: South African spiced beef bake with curry, chutney and an egg custard topping
m.how: Soak 2 slices bread in milk. Fry 800g beef mince with an onion, 1 tbsp curry powder and 1 tsp turmeric, then stir in 2 tbsp mango chutney and the squeezed bread. Press into a dish, pour over 2 eggs beaten with 200ml milk, add bay leaves and bake at 180C for 35 minutes.

w.note: Chocolate mousse, cookie dirt, gummy worms and mint. Slimy yet satisfying.
w.how: Melt 150g dark chocolate, whisk in 2 yolks and fold in 2 whipped whites and 150ml whipped cream. Spoon into 4 cups and chill 3 hours. Top with crushed chocolate biscuits, push in gummy worms and add a mint leaf.

w.note: Cardamom coconut doughnut triangles, fried and dusted with icing sugar
w.how: Mix 400g flour, 7g yeast, 80g sugar, 1 tsp cardamom and 250ml warm coconut milk to a soft dough and rest an hour. Roll out, cut into triangles and fry at 170C until puffed and golden. Dust with icing sugar.

d.note: Mango, pineapple and passionfruit punch topped with lemonade and lime
d.how: Mix 400ml mango nectar, 400ml pineapple juice and the pulp of 3 passionfruit. Pour over crushed ice in four glasses, top with lemonade and squeeze in some lime.
